# HEX API

> Hosted AI model APIs for developers, including named Uncensored and Abliterated variants.

## Model discovery
- [Live HEX model catalog](https://hexapi.io/models)
- [Active model pages](https://github.com/hexapi-io/hex-model-catalog/blob/main/MODEL-INDEX.md)
- [Uncensored and abliterated models](https://github.com/hexapi-io/hex-model-catalog/blob/main/UNCENSORED-MODELS.md)
- [Structured catalog snapshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hexapi-io/hex-model-catalog/main/models.json)
- [AI jailbreak and model variant terminology](https://github.com/hexapi-io/hex-model-catalog/blob/main/JAILBREAK-AND-MODEL-VARIANTS.md)
